item.title: Parameter Rename
item.description: On 2026-11-01, we will rename max_tokens to max_output_tokens for API versions 2025-06 and later.

item.title: Model Deprecation
item.description: Model acme-pro-2025-01 will be retired on 2026-12-15. Please migrate to acme-pro-2026-06.

item.title: Performance
item.description: We decreased the default temperature for all models to improve response determinism.

item.title: New Feature
item.description: Added the optional top_k parameter to the chat endpoint to filter sampling.
